id: # lane/divlib: lane/chain3's library-start divergence, root-caused (the same id: this row's status wins the merge)

cause: every library-kills checkpoint kept its save packed (cp/save.tar.zst, harvest.sh --pack) and session.c resolve_checkpoint took cp/save on trust: no region files, so every chunk the checkpoint's save held and the snapshot did not was generated afresh. From s42-s42k20-end a path search in the overworld loads chunks (-14..-9, -22) at t 95: Java reads them with seven entities, C generated them (w.bc 3437 against 0, w.ents 289 against 296); the seeder fell seven draws behind (d.sseed), and by t 1567 the dragon's flight differed: its body hits Java's player (16.12 to 13.24), not the env's. Now a checkpoint start without cp/save refuses (engine/cpsave.c), and both libraries are unpacked
repro: ~/.cache/netherite-native/dragon-kill/diff-libstart-s42end; test_snapshots of its java/ka-s42n with the tape's checkpoint pointed at a packed copy: first differing row 95 before, refused after; vecplay from the unpacked library start: 2600 of 2600 rows equal Java's
